reason: A DSH web plugin for per-host personalization, centered on local long-term memory and custom prompt context, with reply-tone presets and settings UI. It stores data locally and provides agent memory tools without evidence of external services.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供本机个性化功能，包括自定义指令、本地长期记忆、回复语气预设和双语设置面板。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with per-host personalization through custom instructions, local long-term memory, reply-tone presets, and a bilingual settings panel.

capabilities: Injects user-defined instructions and stored memory into conversation system prompts
Persists configuration and memory entries as local JSON files
Provides agent tools to create, list, update, and delete memory entries
Exposes a loopback and same-origin browser API for configuration and memory operations
Adds a bilingual personalization panel to the web app settings
